title: Section 2(k) - Definition of employee
summary: An employee means any person employed on wages by an establishment to do any skilled, semi-skilled or unskilled, manual, operational, supervisory, managerial, administrative, technical or clerical work.

title: Section 2(y) - Definition of wages
summary: Wages means all remuneration including salary, allowances and monetary entitlements payable to an employed person in respect of employment or work done in such employment.

title: Section 17 - Mode and time limit for payment of wages
summary: Wages shall be paid by the employer before the expiry of the 7th day after the last day of the wage-period, or within 2 working days in case of removal, dismissal, retrenchment or resignation.

title: Section 18 - Deductions which may be made from wages
summary: No deductions shall be made from the wages of an employee except those authorised under the Code. Any unauthorized deduction or non-payment of earned wages constitutes an illegal withholding of wages.

title: Section 45 - Claims under Code and procedure thereof
summary: An employee, registered trade union, or Inspector-cum-Facilitator may file a claim application before the Gazetted Authority appointed by the appropriate Government for recovery of unpaid wages or unauthorized deductions.

title: Section 45(6) - Period of limitation for claims
summary: Every application under Section 45 shall be filed within a period of three years from the date on which the claim for unpaid wages or unauthorized deduction arose.

title: Section 51 - Appeal
summary: Any person aggrieved by an order of the Authority under Section 45 may appeal to the Appellate Authority within thirty days from the date of the order.
